Container.Name: twitch-channel-miner
Container.Overview: Self-hosted multi-user Twitch Channel Points miner with a web dashboard. Earns watch-time points and claims bonus chests, drops, raids and predictions through real Twitch APIs. Use the :latest-node tag if the container exits with "Illegal instruction" (CPU without AVX2).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database (miner.db plus its -wal/-shm files). Stop the container before copying it.

Config.Name: APP_URL
Config.Description: The exact origin you open the dashboard on (scheme, host and port). OAuth redirects and the session cookie depend on it.

Config.Name: TWITCH_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Must stay the Twitch TV client id. A client id from dev.twitch.tv gets 401 on every authenticated GQL call.

Config.Name: ALLOW_REGISTRATION
Config.Description: The first account can always register. Set to true to allow additional accounts.

Config.Name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Optional. Enables Sign in with Google. Redirect URI: APP_URL/api/auth/google/callback
